findings.title: Commit subjects carry ticket key inline
findings.problem: git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns: the ticket key belongs in the body footer; 7 commit subjects in the review range carry EPMCDME-17854 inline. commitlint does not enforce it.
findings.impact: A documented commit-format convention is not met across the review range and no automated gate catches it.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subjects to <type>(<scope>): <subject> and move EPMCDME-17854 to the body footer (or accept the squash-merge title carrying the convention).

findings.title: Undelivered flag not reset between retry sends
findings.problem: With retryOnce, the shared undelivered flag stays true after a first refused send. If the retry then fails ambiguously (timeout or reset after the daemon spooled), the batch is both spooled and held.
findings.impact: Duplicate delivery on a narrow sequence (refused, then daemon up, then ambiguous failure); retries reuse event_ids, so spool dedupe is expected to absorb it (not verified).
findings.recommendation: Reset undelivered.value = false at the start of each send.

findings.title: Refused-connection detection too narrow
findings.problem: isConnectionRefused checks only err.code and err.cause.code for ECONNREFUSED. A refusal nested in an AggregateError's errors[] (dual-stack) would be treated as ambiguous and the start not held.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger; reachability unconfirmed. Node's AggregateError often carries the code itself, and the session start would be lost only in the shape that lacks it.
